title_zh: 核对旧碗真伪后决定暂不购买

scenario.label_zh: 核对二手碗真伪与损伤
scenario.goal_zh: 了解卖方无法保证年代及现有磨损情况，决定先查看来源资料而不购买

context_zh: 顾客在二手商店询问一个被标为老物件的陶碗。
author: author-phase08-a

sentences.speaker: Celia
sentences.text: Is this a genuine antique, or a modern copy?

sentences.speaker: Owen
sentences.text: I don't know its age. It came from a house clearance, without any documents.

sentences.speaker: Celia
sentences.text: Can you give me a guarantee that it's at least a hundred years old?

sentences.speaker: Owen
sentences.text: No, I can't. There's also a chip under the base. I can show you that, but I can't rule out hidden damage.

sentences.speaker: Celia
sentences.text: I appreciate your honesty. I like it, but the age matters because it's for a collector.

sentences.speaker: Owen
sentences.text: The owner may still have the purchase receipt. I can ask.

sentences.speaker: Celia
sentences.text: Please do. I'll leave it for now and come back if there's more information.
